title: StepResult

step.description: A step with an entry in the step registry: account, your-machines, browser, permissions, appearance.

state.description: What a step's check found: done, needs-attention, or skipped (a skippable step a person skipped; never a preference step).

reason.description: One line for the step's row: what needs attention, naming each check that failed; when the step is done, what its checks found to hold.

failing.description: The checks that did not hold, in the entry's order: a settings key its value check refused, or a state check's id (permissions.containment, ...); empty when done.

items.description: A named action a step's result offers, from ADR 0031's fixed vocabulary: sign-in-again, pull-now, check-again, unpair, pair-another, install, update, reload, set-up-this-machine, restore (the Permissions step: the denylist's presets), move.

actions.description: The actions to offer beside the reason: those of the checks that failed, each once; empty when done.

checkedAt.description: When the check ran, on the environment's clock.

description: A step's health check: its state, one line naming what failed, the checks that failed, the actions to offer and when it ran (ADR 0031).
